import fcntl,os,subprocess,sys,time,traceback
from pathlib import Path
from experiments.offline_camera_retrain_v1.ops import ego_scene_evaluation as e
trial=e.review.BASE/'runs/native30_ego_scene_fusion_v2';out=trial/'final_evaluation'
module='experiments.offline_camera_retrain_v1.ops.ego_scene_evaluation'
record=dict(protocol='fixed-final3000-two-seed-sequential-evaluation-v1',status='waiting_training',started_at=e.review.common.now(),pid=os.getpid(),stage_updates=3000,expected_predictions_per_seed=344,expected_total_predictions=688,cohort_panel='all',recordings=43,dev_recordings=12,confirmation_recordings=31,diffusion_seed_indices=[0,1],TEST_used=False,physics_OFF_all=True,automatic_training_extension=False,automatic_checkpoint_promotion=False,events=[])
def save(): e.write(out/'PIPELINE.json',record)
def child(stage,command,destination,*options):
 argv=[sys.executable,'-u','-m',module,command,'--out',str(destination),*map(str,options)]
 event=dict(stage=stage,command=argv,status='running',started_at=e.review.common.now());record['events'].append(event);record['status']=stage;save()
 with (out/(stage+'.log')).open('a') as stream:
  proc=subprocess.Popen(argv,cwd=e.review.common.ROOT,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONUNBUFFERED='1'),stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  event['pid']=proc.pid;save()
  while True:
   try: result=proc.wait(timeout=30);break
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    record['heartbeat_at']=e.review.common.now()
    status_path=destination/'STATUS.json'
    if status_path.exists():
     current=e.read(status_path);record['child_snapshot']={key:current[key] for key in ['status','pid','checked_at','completed_predictions','planned_predictions','dataset','case','model','regime'] if key in current}
    save()
 event.update(status='completed' if result==0 else 'failed',returncode=result,ended_at=e.review.common.now());save()
 e.require(result==0,'Final child failed: '+stage)
with (out/'driver.lock').open('a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 try:
  e.require(e.sha256(e.__file__)=='09e0e896c641f5d9a6307018c707952bbadc4ced7a3a6fd8de19b13cedf80a16','Evaluator source changed')
  cohort=e.verify_cohort(e.DEFAULT_COHORT)
  deadline=time.monotonic()+10*3600
  while True:
   p=e.read(trial/'PIPELINE.json');a=e.read(trial/'MATCHED_AUDIT.json')
   statuses={arm:e.read(trial/arm/'STATUS.json') for arm in ('control','fusion')}
   record['training_snapshot']=dict(pipeline_status=p['status'],updates={arm:state.get('step') for arm,state in statuses.items()},audit_status=a['status'],audit_updates=a['updates_per_arm'],checked_at=e.review.common.now());save()
   e.require(p['status']!='failed','Training3000 pipeline failed')
   if p['status']=='completed':
    e.require(p['stop_step']==3000 and p['final_steps']==dict(control=3000,fusion=3000),'Training boundary differs')
    e.require(a['status']=='passed' and a['updates_per_arm']==3000 and a['plan_sha256']==e.sha256(trial/'PLAN.json'),'Matched3000 audit missing or different')
    e.require(a['physics_OFF_both'] and a['parent_step']==41000,'Training protocol differs')
    break
   e.require(time.monotonic()<deadline,'Timed out waiting for3000 paired audit')
   os.kill(p['pid'],0);time.sleep(30)
  for source,target in [('PIPELINE.json','TRAINING_PIPELINE3000.json'),('MATCHED_AUDIT.json','MATCHED_AUDIT3000.json')]:
   e.require(not (out/target).exists(),'Training archive already exists')
   e.write(out/target,e.read(trial/source));e.require(e.sha256(out/target)==e.sha256(trial/source),'Training archive bytes differ')
  source=e.read(Path(cohort['source'])/'PLAN.json')
  models=dict(base41k=dict(source['models']['candidate41k'],architecture='original',arms=['learned_only']))
  for arm,architecture,arms in [('control','original',['learned_only']),('fusion','scene_fusion_v2',['learned_only','none'])]:
   checkpoint=trial/arm/'training/last.pt'
   e.require(e.sha256(checkpoint)==a['checkpoint_sha256'][arm],'Checkpoint differs from matched3000 audit')
   models[arm]=dict(checkpoint=str(checkpoint.resolve()),checkpoint_sha256=a['checkpoint_sha256'][arm],expected_step=3000,architecture=architecture,arms=arms)
  registry=out/'INPUT_MODELS.json';e.write(registry,models)
  record['matched_audit3000_sha256']=e.sha256(out/'MATCHED_AUDIT3000.json');record['training_pipeline3000_sha256']=e.sha256(out/'TRAINING_PIPELINE3000.json');save()
  seed_outputs=[trial/'final_seed0',trial/'final_seed1']
  for seed,destination in enumerate(seed_outputs):
   child('prepare_seed'+str(seed),'prepare',destination,'--models',registry,'--panel','all','--seed-index',seed,'--arms','learned_only')
   plan=e.read(destination/'PLAN.json')
   e.require(plan['planned_predictions']==344 and len(plan['entries'])==43 and plan['diffusion_seed_index']==seed and plan['evaluation_panel']=='all','Final cohort/seed differs')
   e.require({label:declaration['arms'] for label,declaration in plan['models'].items()}=={label:declaration['arms'] for label,declaration in models.items()},'Mixed arm registry differs')
   e.require(all(plan['models'][arm]['stage_plan_sha256']==a['plan_sha256'] for arm in ('control','fusion')),'Training stage differs')
   e.require(all(e.sha256(declaration['checkpoint'])==models[label]['checkpoint_sha256'] for label,declaration in plan['models'].items()),'Pinned final checkpoint differs')
  record['both_seeds_pinned_before_sampling']=True;save()
  for seed,destination in enumerate(seed_outputs):
   child('evaluate_seed'+str(seed),'evaluate',destination,'--resume','--memory-fraction','.65')
   child('recheck_seed'+str(seed),'recheck',destination)
   proof=e.read(destination/'CPU_RECHECK.json')
   e.require(proof['status']=='independent_cpu_passed' and proof['predictions']==344 and not proof['CUDA_initialized'],'Seed CPU recheck failed')
  combined=trial/'final_combined'
  child('combine','combine',combined,'--inputs',*seed_outputs)
  e.require(e.read(combined/'SEED_COMPARISON.json')['paired_predictions']==344,'Combined seed completeness differs')
  child('decision','decision',combined,'--inputs',*seed_outputs,'--acceptance',e.DEFAULT_ACCEPTANCE)
  verdict=e.read(combined/'DECISION.json')
  record.update(status='completed',ended_at=e.review.common.now(),completed_predictions=688,decision_status=verdict['status'],DECISION_sha256=e.sha256(combined/'DECISION.json'),seed_outputs=[dict(path=str(path.resolve()),PLAN_sha256=e.sha256(path/'PLAN.json'),rows_sha256=e.sha256(path/'rows.jsonl'),CPU_RECHECK_sha256=e.sha256(path/'CPU_RECHECK.json')) for path in seed_outputs]);save()
 except BaseException as exc:
  record.update(status='failed',ended_at=e.review.common.now(),error=repr(exc));save();traceback.print_exc();raise
policy: Wait completed matched3000 audit; archive original bytes; CPU pin both seed registries before sampling; sequential344 GPU predictions and freshCPU recheck per seed; average both seeds and apply frozen acceptance; no TEST, training extension or model promotion.
